tagline: Museum-grade archival prints of Clodagh’s most beloved poems, individually numbered, signed, and bespoke-framed.
description: Each limited edition poem is printed on heavyweight archival cotton rag paper, hand-signed and numbered by Clodagh Beresford Dunne, and presented in a handcrafted frame ready to hang or gift.

items.title: ‘Seven Sugar Cubes’ — Framed Signed Limited Edition
items.subtitle: Irish Book Awards — Irish Poem of the Year Winner
items.edition: Signed & Numbered Limited Edition • Bespoke Hardwood Frame
items.description: An archival fine-art presentation of ‘Seven Sugar Cubes’ (voted Irish Poem of the Year at the Irish Book Awards), typeset in classic left-aligned literary serif on museum-grade cotton rag paper and signed by the poet. Optional personal dedication inscription available on request.
features: Individually hand-signed and numbered by Clodagh Beresford Dunne
Printed on 310gsm acid-free archival cotton rag paper
Conservation mount and solid wood frame (choice of black, natural oak, or warm white)
Optional handwritten dedication on the reverse or accompanying gift card
items.poemPreview: “...drive the winter miles to your / father’s field, where you know his horses will run to / the rattle, like dice, of seven sugar cubes.”

items.title: ‘The Bulbs He Planted’ — Framed Signed Limited Edition
items.subtitle: First Published in The High Window
items.edition: Signed & Numbered Limited Edition • Bespoke Hardwood Frame
items.description: A deeply moving gift of remembrance and consolation (‘When in June his alliums / surprise you from the soil... Now the triumphant globes / link this earth to heaven’), hand-signed and framed to gallery standard.
features: Hand-signed and numbered limited edition print
Ideal commemorative or bereavement gift
Archival cotton paper with UV-protective glazing
Carefully packaged for tracked shipping across Ireland and internationally
items.poemPreview: “When in June his alliums / surprise you from the soil / it’s as if the spheres / are suspended from above...”

items.title: Your Choice of Poem — Framed Signed Limited Edition
items.subtitle: Any Published Poem from the Repository
items.edition: Custom Bespoke Framed Edition • Signed by the Poet
items.description: Select any poem from Clodagh’s published work—including ‘Ford Galaxy’, ‘Cordgrass’, ‘Brother’, ‘Chocolate Advent Calendar’, ‘Morning With Four Children’, or ‘At The Wall Near The Road’—to be archivals-printed, hand-signed, and framed to order.
features: Choose any of the 19 poems in the online repository
Set in Clodagh’s exact authorial typography and stanza layout
Hand-signed with optional personal inscription
Bespoke framing included
items.poemPreview: Select your favourite poem when ordering and include any personal dedication instructions.

tagline: Unframed collector’s poetry broadsides printed on fine heavy laid paper and hand-signed by the poet.
description: Steeped in the Irish literary tradition of collectible broadsheets, these unframed signed prints are ready for your own framing or presentation folder.

items.title: ‘Seven Sugar Cubes’ — Signed Collector’s Broadside
items.subtitle: Unframed Archival Broadside (A4 / A3)
items.edition: Hand-Signed Archival Broadside on Heavy Cotton Paper
items.description: Unframed fine-press style broadside of Clodagh’s award-winning poem ‘Seven Sugar Cubes’, printed on textured cream archival paper and signed in ink by the author.
features: Hand-signed by Clodagh Beresford Dunne
Heavyweight 300gsm textured archival paper
Standard framing dimensions for effortless custom framing
Shipped flat in rigid conservation board packaging
items.poemPreview: “Does the news melt into you and cool to the image of / his remains in a Tasmanian Blackwood coffin...”

items.title: Signed Poetry Broadside — Your Choice of Poem
items.subtitle: ‘Cordgrass’, ‘Ford Galaxy’, ‘One Hazard of a Messy Home’ & More
items.description: Order an unframed, hand-signed broadside of any poem from Clodagh’s collection—preserving the exact visual and spatial typography of works like ‘Cordgrass’, ‘Ford Galaxy’, and ‘One Hazard of a Messy Home’.
features: Available for any poem in the collection
True-to-manuscript left-aligned and spatial serif typesetting
Signed and dated by the poet (personal dedication optional)
Worldwide protective flat shipping
items.poemPreview: “In the vastness of Scarborough Marsh / the Great Blue Heron patiently waits on one leg...”

tagline: Give the gift of poetry: redeemable against retreats, workshops, one-to-one consultations, student courses, or signed editions.
description: Presented as a beautifully printed and hand-signed gift voucher (posted in a presentation envelope or emailed for instant gifting), Gift Tokens can be redeemed against any of Clodagh’s courses, full-day retreats, workshops, mentoring sessions, or limited-edition prints.

items.title: Full-Day Retreat or Poetry Workshop Gift Token
items.subtitle: Covers 1 Full-Day Workshop or Retreat Place (Lunch Included)
items.edition: Presentation Gift Voucher (Posted or Digital PDF)
items.description: Treat a writer or poetry lover in your life to a full-day poetry workshop or creative writing retreat with Clodagh at Colligan Falls, Co. Waterford (including morning coffee, afternoon tea, lunch, and written follow-up feedback).
features: Redeemable against any Full-Day Poetry Workshop or Adult Creative Writing Retreat
Valid for 24 months from date of issue
Sent as a hand-signed luxury card by post or instant printable PDF
Includes space for your personal gift message
items.poemPreview: “I write words – and help others find theirs.”

features: Redeemable for an in-person or online 1-to-1 consultation
Includes close written appraisal of up to 6 poems
Valid for 24 months
Posted gift card or immediate digital delivery
